question:
A paper is folded and cut as shown. How will it appear when unfolded ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd556b967e2147cd460e42ff39d4553549502937acb8630478c131031bc4be4d.png]
solution:
If you see the question properly the paper has been folded symmetrically from the middle and then again through the line.

**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a599a673fbd0a07867a45aa8c1b487e5a5e10608ae45e7ce6414b0919ee5fb17.png] 

This will divide the figure into four squares and each square will contain 3 circles along the adjacent sides, when the paper will be folded the circles should overlap each other which can be only seen in Option 4 while all the other three options are asymmetrical.

Thus the correct answer is option 4)**
